_readme: STARTER PACK — authored to be REPLACED by upstream. JSON has no comment syntax, so this
key is the header comment; the loader ignores unknown keys.
Nobody at Sparkle is an authority on what the law says. The HumaneBench project and
community are expected to define and maintain the real packs; this exists so the
mechanism has something to run against on day one.
Every 'guidance' string below is a NON-AUTHORITATIVE PLAIN-LANGUAGE PARAPHRASE. The
'source' URL governs. Effective dates are the pack author's reading of the instrument
and must be confirmed by counsel.
This pack never asserts compliance. A check that does not fire means nothing fired —
not that a product is lawful.
notice: Guidance text is a non-authoritative paraphrase; the source URL governs.

checks.title: Withdrawing consent must be as easy as giving it
checks.guidance: that a person can withdraw consent as easily as they gave it, and that they be told so before they consent

checks.title: Data protection by design and by default

detect.question: Does this change collect, store, share or expose personal data BY DEFAULT — that is, without the person having deliberately turned it on?

checks.guidance: that privacy-protective settings be the default, so that personal data is not made accessible to more people, or kept for longer, than the feature actually needs

checks.title: Data minimisation

detect.question: Does this change capture personal data fields that the feature it implements does not actually need in order to work?

checks.guidance: that personal data be adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary for the stated purpose
